description: This file defines server-side load and action functions for managing invoice product data in a SvelteKit application. It handles fetching product lists with filters, as well as create, update, and delete operations for invoice products via API requests to a Django backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes the list of products with filtering, sorting, and pagination, transforming the data for frontend use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new product by sending data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by productId with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product identified by productId.
